title: Delete asks for confirmation and removes an unused term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-25 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  5. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  6. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a confirmation opens titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Delete Credit Term".
  • Step 3: the confirmation closes and {Term-A} is still listed.
  • Step 4: the menu opens.
  • Step 5: the confirmation opens again.
  • Step 6: the confirmation closes, {Term-A} is removed from the page, the Active count goes down by 1, and a green toast shows "{Term-A} deleted".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R9: “"Delete Credit Term" opens a confirmation titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Delete Credit Term". On confirm the term is removed from the page and a success toast shows "{name} deleted".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Delete Credit Term chosen | "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" | Confirmation titled "Confirmation", buttons "Cancel" and red "Delete Credit Term"”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Term deleted | "{name} deleted" | Success toast”
  • Key Decisions: “Deleting a term asks for confirmation; deactivating, reactivating and making a term the default are confirmed only where the result is not obvious. Delete is permanent and asks first. Deactivate and Reactivate are reversible and act at once with a toast. Make Default confirms, because its effect on existing customers (none) needs saying.”
  • Key Decisions: “Once a term is in use (by any customer, vendor or invoice), its name and days are locked; it can be deactivated but not deleted. An unused term can be edited or deleted.”
